response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT t.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), grp AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM joined GROUP BY transreg, tradekind) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM grp GROUP BY tradekind
